test_details.name: test_api_submit_task_creates_sql_queue_and_outbox_event
test_details.outcome: SqlWorkSubmissionAdapter saves TaskRunORM and TaskSubmitted OutboxRecordORM in one transaction.

test_details.name: test_worker_claims_sql_task_atomically
test_details.outcome: SqlDurableTaskQueue atomically claims pending task, bumps generation, and returns ClaimedTask.

test_details.name: test_two_workers_concurrent_claim
test_details.outcome: Two concurrent worker claim calls result in exactly one successful claim winner.

test_details.name: test_task_non_reclaimable_before_lease_expiry
test_details.outcome: Claimed task cannot be claimed by another worker before lease expiry.

test_details.name: test_task_reclaimable_after_lease_expiry
test_details.outcome: Expired lease task is reclaimed with incremented generation and new fencing token.

test_details.name: test_fencing_token_validation_prevents_stale_renewal
test_details.outcome: Renewal with mismatched fencing token is rejected.

test_details.name: test_production_worker_durable_tick
test_details.outcome: ProductionWorker tick claims and completes task via SqlDurableTaskQueue.
